name: ZooCrew at Buttonwood Park Zoo
description_short: A day camp at Buttonwood Park Zoo for ages 4-12, with a different animal or nature theme each week. Days include crafts, games, activities and animal encounters, plus recess in the Nature Play area. Summer runs in July and August, with short programs in February and April.
refund_policy_summary: Cancellations are accepted until the week before your child's start date. After that there are no refunds, except for cancellations due to a Covid diagnosis.
